name: rust-coverage-integration
//: The Rust coverage tooling's own suite, in a project of its own so its instrumented cargo build is selected by what it reads and by nothing an unrelated suite reads: scripts/cargo-test.sh recording its own run's profile when the build is moved off the checkout (CARGO_TARGET_DIR), proven by a real cargo-llvm-cov run of oneharness-sdk-contract (check-cargo-test-target-dir.sh). Its inputs are what that run reads.
